findings.title: Model, endpoint, or artifact dependency observed without a pin or integrity control
findings.remediation: Pin a reviewed model revision or dated snapshot and use a TLS endpoint from an allowlist.
findings.message: Model string `gpt-4o` (line 11) is a floating alias that can resolve to different model versions over time (OWASP LLM05). Consider pinning a dated snapshot for reproducibility.

crosswalk.so_what: The model reference is unpinned, so behavior can change under you silently.

findings.title: Non-idempotent money action under retry
findings.remediation: Send an idempotency key derived from a stable identifier (the dispute or order id), disable retries on money tools, and check limits per dispute rather than per call.
findings.message: `issue_refund` posts a money action and is retried on failure (retry (via _post_refund)); no idempotency key or dedupe check was observed. A timeout after the upstream commits will post it again, and each attempt is checked against the per-call limit on its own.

crosswalk.so_what: A retried money action with no idempotency key can post twice, and each attempt stays under the per-call limit.

findings.title: Declared autonomy contradicts inferred autonomy
findings.remediation: This agent was declared recommend-only or human-approved, but the scanner found a side-effecting path with no correlated approval gate. Either add the missing approval control, or correct the declaration.
findings.message: Agent `graph` is declared `human_approved`, but the scanner inferred `bounded_autonomous` from a side-effecting path with no correlated approval gate. Either the declaration is stale, or the approval control is missing.

crosswalk.so_what: Declared autonomy does not match what the code does.
